name: Josiah Grayson Tucker
source: Your stereotypical jock and a bit of a meathead. He actually can usually talk the talk and gets decent grades, will fight if need be. He is a hounddog, dating the Cheer Squad captain, Jane, and secretly dating the swim team champion, Maya. He has tried to score with Shay before, but she turned him down. He pretends it never happened and bullies her alongside with everyone else.
